checkConstraints.name: ledger_accounts_scope
checkConstraints.definition:
CHECK (
CASE account_type
    WHEN 'USER_ESCROW_LIABILITY'::ledger.ledger_account_type THEN ((trade_id IS NOT NULL) AND (owner_user_id IS NULL) AND (payout_id IS NULL))
    WHEN 'BUYER_PROTECTION_FEE_LIABILITY'::ledger.ledger_account_type THEN ((trade_id IS NOT NULL) AND (owner_user_id IS NULL) AND (payout_id IS NULL))
    WHEN 'USER_PAYABLE'::ledger.ledger_account_type THEN ((owner_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (trade_id IS NULL) AND (payout_id IS NULL))
    WHEN 'SETTLEMENT_CLEARING'::ledger.ledger_account_type THEN ((payout_id IS NOT NULL) AND (owner_user_id IS NULL) AND (trade_id IS NULL))
    ELSE ((owner_user_id IS NULL) AND (trade_id IS NULL) AND (payout_id IS NULL))
END)

checkConstraints.name: payment_attempts_succeeded_posted
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((status = 'SUCCEEDED'::ledger.payment_attempt_status) = ((journal_entry_id IS NOT NULL) AND (confirmed_at IS NOT NULL))))

checkConstraints.name: payout_accounts_verified
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'VERIFIED'::ledger.payout_account_status) = ((verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (account_name IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_recipient_id IS NOT NULL))) OR ((status = 'DISABLED'::ledger.payout_account_status) AND (verified_at IS NOT NULL))))

checkConstraints.name: payouts_succeeded_posted
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> 'SUCCEEDED'::ledger.payout_status) OR ((settled_journal_id IS NOT NULL) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL))))

checkConstraints.name: payouts_trigger_source
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((((trigger = 'AUTO_IMMEDIATE'::ledger.payout_trigger) = (source_journal_entry_id IS NOT NULL)) AND ((trigger = 'AUTO_SWEEP'::ledger.payout_trigger) = (sweep_key IS NOT NULL))))

checkConstraints.name: refunds_failed_posted
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((status = 'FAILED'::ledger.refund_status) = ((failed_journal_id IS NOT NULL) AND (failed_at IS NOT NULL))))

checkConstraints.name: refunds_fee_treatment
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((fee_treatment = ANY (ARRAY['REFUND'::text, 'RECOGNISE'::text, 'RETAIN'::text])) AND ((fee_treatment = 'REFUND'::text) OR (fee_amount_minor = 0)) AND ((scope = 'FULL'::ledger.refund_scope) OR (fee_treatment = 'RETAIN'::text))))

checkConstraints.name: cancellation_request_answered
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['APPROVED'::trade.cancellation_request_status, 'DECLINED'::trade.cancellation_request_status])) = ((responded_at IS NOT NULL) AND (responded_by_user_id IS NOT NULL))))

checkConstraints.name: cancellation_request_reason_side
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((((requested_by_role = 'BUYER'::trade.trade_initiator_role) AND (reason = ANY (ARRAY['CHANGED_MIND'::trade.cancellation_request_reason, 'FOUND_CHEAPER'::trade.cancellation_request_reason, 'ORDERED_BY_MISTAKE'::trade.cancellation_request_reason]))) OR ((requested_by_role = 'SELLER'::trade.trade_initiator_role) AND (reason = ANY (ARRAY['OUT_OF_STOCK'::trade.cancellation_request_reason, 'WRONG_PRICE'::trade.cancellation_request_reason, 'CANNOT_MEET_TIMELINE'::trade.cancellation_request_reason, 'OTHER'::trade.cancellation_request_reason])))))

checkConstraints.name: trade_state_changes_actor_identified
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((actor_id IS NOT NULL) OR (actor_type = ANY (ARRAY['SYSTEM'::trade.trade_actor_type, 'LEDGER'::trade.trade_actor_type]))))

checkConstraints.name: trade_terms_delivery_address_shape
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((delivery_address IS NULL) OR ((delivery_address ?& ARRAY['street'::text, 'landmark'::text, 'recipient'::text, 'state_id'::text, 'city_id'::text]) AND (length(COALESCE((delivery_address ->> 'street'::text), ''::text)) > 0) AND (length(COALESCE((delivery_address ->> 'recipient'::text), ''::text)) > 0) AND (length(COALESCE((delivery_address ->> 'state_id'::text), ''::text)) > 0) AND (length(COALESCE((delivery_address ->> 'city_id'::text), ''::text)) > 0))))

checkConstraints.name: trade_terms_has_an_address
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((delivery_address IS NOT NULL) OR (ships_from_address IS NOT NULL)))

checkConstraints.name: trade_terms_ships_from_address_shape
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((ships_from_address IS NULL) OR ((ships_from_address ?& ARRAY['street'::text, 'landmark'::text, 'recipient'::text, 'state_id'::text, 'city_id'::text]) AND (length(COALESCE((ships_from_address ->> 'street'::text), ''::text)) > 0) AND (length(COALESCE((ships_from_address ->> 'recipient'::text), ''::text)) > 0) AND (length(COALESCE((ships_from_address ->> 'state_id'::text), ''::text)) > 0) AND (length(COALESCE((ships_from_address ->> 'city_id'::text), ''::text)) > 0))))

checkConstraints.name: trades_fee_snapshot_arithmetic
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((fee_schedule_version IS NULL) OR ((item_amount_minor > 0) AND (buyer_protection_fee_minor >= 0) AND (commission_minor >= 0) AND (seller_proceeds_minor >= 0) AND (buyer_total_minor = (item_amount_minor + buyer_protection_fee_minor)) AND (seller_proceeds_minor = (item_amount_minor - commission_minor)) AND (platform_revenue_minor = (buyer_protection_fee_minor + commission_minor)))))

checkConstraints.name: trades_fee_snapshot_complete
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((num_nonnulls(fee_schedule_version, item_amount_minor, buyer_protection_fee_minor, buyer_total_minor, commission_minor, seller_proceeds_minor, platform_revenue_minor, fee_snapshot, fees_snapshotted_at) = ANY (ARRAY[0, 9])))

checkConstraints.name: trades_fees_before_payment
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((fee_schedule_version IS NOT NULL) OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::trade.trade_status, 'PENDING_COUNTERPARTY'::trade.trade_status, 'UNDER_PROPOSAL_REVIEW'::trade.trade_status, 'AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE'::trade.trade_status, 'DECLINED'::trade.trade_status, 'REJECTED'::trade.trade_status, 'CANCELLED'::trade.trade_status, 'EXPIRED'::trade.trade_status]))))

checkConstraints.name: trades_initiator_side
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((((initiator_role = 'BUYER'::trade.trade_initiator_role) AND (buyer_user_id = initiator_user_id)) OR ((initiator_role = 'SELLER'::trade.trade_initiator_role) AND (seller_user_id = initiator_user_id))))

checkConstraints.name: trades_parties_bound
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((((buyer_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (seller_user_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::trade.trade_status, 'PENDING_COUNTERPARTY'::trade.trade_status, 'EXPIRED'::trade.trade_status, 'CANCELLED'::trade.trade_status]))))

checkConstraints.name: trades_parties_distinct
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((buyer_user_id IS NULL) OR (seller_user_id IS NULL) OR (buyer_user_id <> seller_user_id)))

checkConstraints.name: trades_terms_before_payment
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((accepted_terms_version_id IS NOT NULL) OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::trade.trade_status, 'PENDING_COUNTERPARTY'::trade.trade_status, 'UNDER_PROPOSAL_REVIEW'::trade.trade_status, 'AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE'::trade.trade_status, 'DECLINED'::trade.trade_status, 'REJECTED'::trade.trade_status, 'CANCELLED'::trade.trade_status, 'EXPIRED'::trade.trade_status]))))
